newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Student killed in Bangladesh campus violence.
newsitem.headline: Student killed in Bangladesh campus violence.

text.p: A Bangladeshi student leader was killed by unidentified gunmen at the Dhaka University campus on Thursday, police said.
Arif Hossain, a leader of the Jatiyabadi Chhatra Dal, the student wing of the opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party, was hit by two bullets fired by the gunmen early on Thursday.
"The bullets hit him on the shoulder and he died of severe bleeding", said a police officer.
The Dhaka University campus has been the scene of frequent political violence that has claimed the lives of at least 20 students in the past decade, police said.
